data.description: The account address for a specific derivation path under the `account_index`.
The [BIP44 derivation path](https://github.com/bitcoin/bips/blob/master/bip-0044.mediawiki) of the address.
`External` or `Internal`, as defined in the activation request.
A standard [BalanceInfo](/komodo-defi-framework/api/common_structures/wallet/#balance-info) object.

TRON GasFree tokens only. The deterministic GasFree custody address (derived via TVM CREATE2) for this address. Present only when the platform coin/token was activated with a [TronGaslessProviderConfig](/komodo-defi-framework/api/common_structures/activation/#tron-gasless-provider-config); omitted otherwise. See [TRON GasFree transfers](/komodo-defi-framework/tutorials/tron-gasfree/).
address format to which the input address should be converted. Possible values: `mixedcase` for ETH/ERC20 coins; `cashaddress` or `standard` for UTXO coins; `contract` or `wallet` for QTUM/QRC20
Optional. Network prefix for `cashaddress` format. Possible values: `bitcoincash` for BCH mainnet; `bchtest` for BCH testnet; `bchreg` for BCH regtest
A standard [balanceInfos](/komodo-defi-framework/api/common_structures/wallet/#balance-info) object. Not included in responses where `get_balances` is `false`
A standard [DerivationMethod](/komodo-defi-framework/api/common_structures/wallet/#derivation-method) object
The public key associated with the seed used to launch Komodo DeFi Framework

TRON GasFree tokens only. The deterministic GasFree custody address (derived via TVM CREATE2) for this address. Tokens sent to it become eligible for gasless transfers. Present only when the platform coin/token was activated with a [TronGaslessProviderConfig](/komodo-defi-framework/api/common_structures/activation/#tron-gasless-provider-config); omitted otherwise. See [TRON GasFree transfers](/komodo-defi-framework/tutorials/tron-gasfree/).
A list of tokens which were successfully activated. Only included in responses where `get_balances` is `false`
The index of the account in the wallet, starting from `0`.
The `chain` is either `External` or `Internal`, and expressed as an integer with `External` being 0 and `Internal` being 1.
The index of the address in the account, starting from `0`.
The derivation path of the address, following the format `m/44'/COIN_ID'/ACCOUNT_ID'/CHAIN/ADDRESS_ID` (or `m/84'/COIN_ID'/ACCOUNT_ID'/CHAIN/ADDRESS_ID` for segwit coins).
The available amount of a coin or token which is ready to be traded or withdrawn.
The amount of a coin or token which is awaiting confirmation on the block chain for an incoming or outgoing transaction.
Defines how keypairs will be generated. Possible values: `Iguana` or `HDWallet`
the fee is paid from the user's balance of this coin. This coin name may differ from the `base` or `rel` coins. For example, ERC20 fees are paid by ETH (gas)
fee amount (in decimal representation)
fee amount (in rational representation)
fee amount (in fraction representation)
whether the fee is paid from trading volume and not use actual `coin` balance
Type of transaction fee. Possible values: `UtxoFixed`, `UtxoPerKbyte`, `UtxoPriority`, `EthGas`, `Qrc20Gas`, `CosmosGas`
Fee amount in coin units, used only when type is `UtxoFixed` (fixed amount not depending on tx size) or `UtxoPerKbyte` (amount per Kbyte)
Used only when type is `UtxoPriority`. Possible values: 'Low', 'Normal', 'High'.
Used only when fee type is `Qrc20Gas` or `EthGas`; sets the gas price in `gwei` units.
Used only when fee type is `CosmosGas`; sets the gas price.
Used only when fee type is `EthGas`; sets the gas limit for transaction
Used only when fee type is `Qrc20Gas` or `CosmosGas`; sets the gas limit for transaction
Filters results by `account_id` or `address_id` part of the derivation path.
`ACCOUNT_ID` child in the `m/44'/COIN'/ACCOUNT_ID'/CHAIN/ADDRESS_ID` BIP44 derivation path.
Optional. `ADDRESS_ID` child in the `m/44'/COIN'/ACCOUNT_ID'/CHAIN/ADDRESS_ID` BIP44 derivation path.

Optional. `Internal`, or `External`. External is used for addresses that are meant to be visible outside of the wallet (e.g. for receiving payments). Internal is used for addresses which are not meant to be visible outside of the wallet and is used for return transaction change.
The transaction id of an unspent transaction from the same wallet output.
The [output index](https://bitcoin.stackexchange.com/questions/100765/what-does-the-index-of-an-utxo-stand-for) of this unspent transaction output.
The [scriptpubkey](https://learnmeabitcoin.com/technical/scriptPubKey) of this unspent transaction output.
The value of this unspent transaction output.
The account address for a specific derivation path under the `account_index`.

The [BIP44 derivation path](https://github.com/bitcoin/bips/blob/master/bip-0044.mediawiki) of the address. If there are no more addresses with balances within the gap limit, the address index will increment.
A standard [BalanceInfo](/komodo-defi-framework/api/common_structures/wallet/#balance-info) object.

TRON GasFree tokens only. The deterministic GasFree custody address (derived via TVM CREATE2) for this address. Present only when the platform coin/token was activated with a [TronGaslessProviderConfig](/komodo-defi-framework/api/common_structures/activation/#tron-gasless-provider-config); omitted otherwise. See [TRON GasFree transfers](/komodo-defi-framework/tutorials/tron-gasfree/).

`Internal`, or `External`. External is used for addresses that are meant to be visible outside of the wallet (e.g. for receiving payments). Internal is used for addresses which are not meant to be visible outside of the wallet and is used for return transaction change.
ETH/EVM coins and tokens only. Options are `Legacy` or `Eip1559`. The type of transaction values being configured.
Optional. Only used if tx_type is `Legacy`. Values are in Gwei. The maximium price per gas unit the user is willing to pay for the transaction.
Optional. Only used if tx_type is `Eip1559`. Values are in Gwei. The maximum amount to pay per unit of gas to get your transaction included in a block.
Optional. Only used if tx_type is `Eip1559`. Values are in Gwei. This is paid directly to the miner, and can be set by the user to attract minimal delay in transaction confirmation.
Optional. Only used if tx_type is `Eip1559`. Estimated minimum transaction wait time in mempool (in ms) for this priority level.
Optional. Only used if tx_type is `Eip1559`. Estimated maximum transaction wait time in mempool (in ms) for this priority level.
The coin type. Currently, only 'Cosmos' and `Qtum` are supported.
The address of the validator to delegate staking to.
The amount of coins to stake send to the validator for delegated staking (Cosmos only - QTUM will stake your whole balance).
The coin type. Currently, only 'Cosmos' is supported.
Return only validators matching a specific status. Options are `Bonded`, `Unbonded`, and `All`. Defaults to `Bonded`.
Optional, defaults to `10`. The number of validators displayed per page in response.
Optional, defaults to `1`. The page offset for items in response.
The coin type. Currently, only 'Cosmos' and `Qtum` are supported.
The address of the validator to delegate staking to.
Defaults to `false`. If `true`, will process unprofitable transactions (reward value less than network fees)
Options are `ContextPrivKey`, `WalletConnect`, `Metamask`, or `Trezor`. Defaults to `ContextPrivKey`.
`WalletConnect` type only. The `session_topic` hex string, returned from the response to [wc_new_connection](/komodo-defi-framework/api/v20-dev/wc_new_connection/#wc-new-connection).
UTXO only. The raw unsigned hex of a proposed transaction.
UTXO only. A list of standard [InputTxns objects](/komodo-defi-framework/api/common_structures/wallet/#input-txns).
ETH/EVM only. A destination address to send the funds to.

ETH/EVM only. The amount of funds to be sent as a string with a `0x` prefix, in [wei](https://ethereum.stackexchange.com/questions/253/the-ether-denominations-are-called-finney-szabo-and-wei-what-who-are-these-na) units.
ETH/EVM only. The maximum gas to be used for sending the transaction, in [gwei](https://eth-converter.com/) units.
ETH/EVM only. Used for EIP-1559 fee policy config. A standard [PayForGas](/komodo-defi-framework/api/common_structures/wallet/#pay-for-gas) object.

`required_balance` in rational representation

Optional. Maximum provider fee (in token units) you authorize for the gasless transfer. The signed TIP-712 permit binds this cap, so the provider cannot charge more. When both this and the token's activation-time `gasless.transfer_max_fee` are set, the lower of the two is bound into the permit; when neither is set, the provider's quoted total fee is bound.
Optional, defaults to `300`. How long (in seconds) the signed permit stays valid for the provider to submit on-chain. Must be greater than zero.

Optional. When `true`, if a gasless transfer is unavailable (e.g. no provider configured or the token is ineligible) the withdrawal falls back to a normal native (TRX-paid) transfer instead of returning an error.
The fee type. Either `Utxo`, `Tendermint`, `Qrc20`, `Eth`, `Tron`, or `TronGasless` (for TRON gasless TRC20 transfers routed through GasFree).
`Utxo` or `Tendermint` type only. The fee amount.
The coin which will be used to pay the transaction fee.
`Eth` type only. The amount of gas to be used for the transaction.
`Eth` or `Qrc20` type only. Price per unit of gas to be used for the transaction.
`Tendermint` or `Qrc20` type only. Maximum gas to be used for the transaction.
`Tendermint` type only. Fee to mine the transaction.
`Eth` or `Tron` type only. For `Eth`: gas price multiplied by gas amount. For `Tron`: sum of bandwidth, energy, and account creation fees.
`Qrc20` type only. Gas price multiplied by gas amount.
`Tron` type only. Transaction size in bytes consumed as bandwidth.
`Tron` type only. Energy units consumed (non-zero for TRC20 transfers).
`Tron` type only. Fee in TRX for bandwidth consumed beyond free allowance.
`Tron` type only. Fee in TRX for energy consumed beyond free allowance.
`Tron` type only. Fee in TRX burned for creating a new account at the destination address. Only present for native TRX transfers to unactivated addresses; omitted otherwise.
`TronGasless` type only. Always `gasless` — indicates a provider-sponsored TRC20 transfer authorized through GasFree.
`TronGasless` type only. Identifier of the GasFree provider that broadcasts the transfer (currently `gasfree`).
`TronGasless` type only. The GasFree custody address the transfer is sent from.
`TronGasless` type only. Provider fee for the transfer, charged in the transferred token (not in TRX).
`TronGasless` type only. Extra fee, charged in the token, when the GasFree address is inactive and must be activated on its first transfer. Omitted when the account is already active.
`TronGasless` type only. Total fee paid in the token, i.e. `transfer_fee` plus `activation_fee` when present.

`TronGasless` type only. The fee cap actually bound into the signed TIP-712 permit: the request/activation cap when one was set, otherwise the provider's quoted total fee. Always present in the `withdraw` response.

`TronGasless` type only. `null` in the `withdraw` response — the transfer is not submitted yet. The tracking id is returned by [send_raw_transaction](/komodo-defi-framework/api/legacy/send_raw_transaction/) when the signed transfer is broadcast to the provider, then used with [gasless::trace_status](/komodo-defi-framework/api/v20/wallet/gasless_trace_status/) or [stream::gasless_trace::enable](/komodo-defi-framework/api/v20/streaming/gasless_trace_enable/).
